business_summary.text: Royal Orchid Hotels operates, leases, manages and franchises hotels across brands including Royal Orchid, Regenta and ICONIQA, with 123 hotels and 11,204 keys in FY26.

call_points.text: Vision 2030 targets 345 hotels and over 22,000 keys, supported by an asset-light model.
Pipeline includes 52 signed hotels comprising over 3,600 rooms.
ICONIQA Mumbai faced notional Ind AS adjustments and pre-operating expense write-offs in its first year.
52+ upcoming hotels with 3,625+ keys are signed, mostly managed.
Ind AS adoption added ₹57.3 Cr notional depreciation and finance cost in FY26, reducing consolidated PAT by ₹15.4 Cr.
ICONIQA recorded ₹32.5 Cr of depreciation and finance cost in FY26 from right-of-use assets and lease liabilities.
JLO Hotels Q4FY26 occupancy was 73% and ARR ₹6,844, up 11.5% YoY.

auditor_history.name: Walker Chandiok & Co LLP
auditor_history.note: Ongoing litigation between shareholders of Ksheer Sagar Developers Private Limited under Sections 241 and 242 of the Companies Act.

penalties.details: Fine of Rs. 11,800 (Eleven Thousand Eight Hundred Only).
penalties.impact: Nil except to the extent of the aforesaid penalty amount.

guidance.statement: ICONIQA Mumbai target annual run-rate of ₹80-100 Cr
Vision 2030: 345+ hotels and 22,000+ keys by FY30

operating_notes.text: Launched Regenta Place Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad with 74 keys, marking entry into Telangana.
ICONIQA Mumbai (292 keys, leased) contributed ₹24.2 Cr Q4FY26 revenue and a ₹7.7 Cr PAT loss; FY26 loss was ₹22.1 Cr.
JLO Hotels Q4FY26 occupancy 73%, ARR ₹6,844; managed portfolio occupancy 59%, ARR ₹4,262.
Ind AS adoption added ₹57.3 Cr notional depreciation and finance cost in FY26, reducing consolidated PAT by ₹15.4 Cr.
ICONIQA Mumbai recorded 62% occupancy in Q4FY26 and 81% in April-May 2026.
Multi Hotels Limited (96.37% held by ROHL, operations not started) was sold to M/s Greenleaf Properties Limited for USD 3,412,500; it ceased to be a subsidiary on June 2, 2026.
Launched Z by Regenta City Centre Ahmedabad with 43 keys in partnership with PrimeStay Hospitality.

holders.name: THE JUPITER GLOBAL FUND - JUPITER INDIA SELECT

timeline.summary: Royal Orchid Hotels announced postal ballot voting results approving Keshav Baljee as Whole-Time Director and remuneration for Arjun Baljee.
Royal Orchid Hotels Limited’s Scrutinizer, Nithyalakshmi Subramanian, submitted the e-voting results report for the Postal Ballot Notice dated April 02, 2026, on May 04, 2026.
Royal Orchid Hotels entered Telangana with the launch of Regenta Place Hi-Tech City, Hyderabad, adding 74 keys.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹113.17 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹7.94 Cr.

Royal Orchid Hotels' Q4 & FY26 investor presentation showed FY26 revenue up 18.4% to ₹406.4 Cr but PAT down 29.8% to ₹33.3 Cr, with ICONIQA Mumbai contributing ₹24.2 Cr Q4 revenue and a ₹22.1 Cr FY26 loss.

Chander Kamal Baljee (Director) declared no encumbrance on Royal Orchid Hotels Limited shares for FY2026 on behalf of Baljees Hotels And Real Estates Private Limited, Group Harsha Farms Private Limited, Group Hotel Stay Longer Private Limited, and himself.
Royal Orchid Hotels hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call on May 26, 2026, discussing financial performance and future expansion.
Royal Orchid Hotels informed the exchange about the Rajasthan High Court order appointing a Sole Arbitrator for Ksheer Sagar Developers disputes.
Royal Orchid Hotels completed the sale of its wholly owned subsidiary Multi Hotels Limited to Tanzania's Greenleaf Properties for USD 3,412,500, receiving the final instalment on June 2, 2026.
On June 8, 2026, Royal Orchid Hotels launched Z by Regenta City Centre Ahmedabad with 43 keys in partnership with PrimeStay Hospitality.
Royal Orchid Hotels launched Regenta Place, Kota through its subsidiary with 57 rooms.

watchlist.text: Shareholder approval for final dividend at AGM

watchlist.response: Management explained that launch and marketing expenses in the first year were treated as operating expenses by auditors, serving as an investment for future yield.
watchlist.text: High pre-operating write-offs and lower-than-expected EBITDA conversion at ICONIQA Mumbai.

watchlist.response: Management noted that newer hotel additions take time to ramp up occupancy, and the asset-light managed segment is positioned for strong future scale.
watchlist.text: Stagnation or flat growth in the managed hotel segment revenue.
